Paulson Assistant Professor of Business Administration Assistant Professor of Business Administration Read more Elisabeth Paulson is an Assistant Professor of Business Administration in the Technology and Operations Management Unit at Harvard Business School. She teaches the first year course on Technology and Operations Management in the required curriculum. Professor Paulson's research is in the area of operations for social good.
